posts.title: Après le déluge
posts.description: Back to normal, more or less. While Trump busies his lame duck self with bringing down what's left of the U.S., I'm rehabilitating a wireless contraption for a guitar playing friend — replacing the battery in the transmitter unit. This, at least, is something I can do. [Update #1] Finished the wireless contraptions. Now on to testing. Always test! [Update #2] Fail.

posts.title: Ballot received
posts.description: I waited a while to check to see if our ballots made it to the County elections board. They have. November 3 isn't far off. I would not be surprised if some manifestation of Motivated Malignity were to overtake a few folks here in freedom's land, but so far things have seemed calm enough.
